name: California Proposition 42
title: California Prohibit New Taxes on Retirement Holdings, Personal Assets, and Savings and Limit Retroactive Taxes Initiative
summary: California Prohibit New Taxes on Retirement Holdings, Personal Assets, and Savings and Limit Retroactive Taxes Initiative. Passing with 54.3% Yes in a state Harris carried by 20 points in 2024, though its support across counties tracks the Trump vote (correlation +0.96 with Trump's 2024 share).
